reason: Yes, the house is due, six years is long enough, but I will simply call our painter. He has done our homes for years, he turns up, and he picks the paint. The money does not matter to me. I have no reason to hand my house to a crew I have never met.
objection: These outfits send a crew that disappears halfway and leaves the house in a mess. A promise on a website does not tell me who will actually be standing in my hall, and with our own man I know exactly who to call.
would_change_my_mind: If our painter were not available this season, or if he himself told me Turbolux paint is better and he would use it, I would go with his suggestion.
